blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Leather science, material properties, workshop safety and manufacturing basics.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: Leather processing, tanning operations, finishing and quality testing.

blocks.label: Year 3
blocks.text: Industrial training, defect analysis, chemical handling and process control.

blocks.label: Year 4 (degree route)
blocks.text: Process improvement, sustainable manufacturing and career preparation.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Leather thickness and strength comparison • Leather defect identification guide • Dyeing and finishing process study • Wastewater reduction proposal.

blocks.text: CSIR–Central Leather Research Institute (CLRI), Chennai, and its regional centres, subject to current openings.

blocks.label: Private
blocks.text: Tanneries, footwear manufacturers, leather-goods factories, testing laboratories and chemical suppliers.

blocks.label: Ideal areas
blocks.text: Leather processing, finishing, quality inspection and laboratory testing.

blocks.label: Specializations
blocks.text: Tanning, dyeing and finishing, leather testing, footwear materials, leather goods, quality control and cleaner production.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Tanneries, footwear, leather garments, bags and accessories, upholstery, leather testing and chemical supply.

blocks.label: Employers
blocks.text: Leather manufacturers, footwear brands, export houses, testing laboratories and leather-processing chemical companies.

blocks.label: Countries to investigate
blocks.text: UK, Italy, Germany, Australia and USA.

blocks.label: Relevant study areas
blocks.text: Leather Technology, Footwear Design and Technology, Materials Science, Fashion Product Development and Sustainable Manufacturing.

blocks.label: Options to investigate
blocks.text: University of Northampton (UK) for footwear and leather-related expertise; specialised Italian footwear and leather institutes; and universities offering materials science or fashion-product programmes in the other countries.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Academic transcripts, English proficiency where required, prerequisite qualifications, portfolio for design-oriented programmes and visa documentation. Verify current course availability and whether the qualification suits a technical processing career.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Leather Processing Technician, Tannery Technician, Quality Inspector, Footwear Materials Technician.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Leather goods, footwear, upholstery, materials testing and manufacturing.
Demand and qualification recognition vary by country. Employment and visa sponsorship are not guaranteed.

Diploma Student ↓ Leather Technician Trainee ↓ Leather Processing Technician ↓ Senior Technician / Quality Inspector ↓ Production / Quality Supervisor ↓ Plant Technical Specialist / Production Manager
Progression depends on technical expertise, experience and employer requirements.
